rule: Freeze scenarios before outcomes; no adjustment of caps, friction or mass to obtain passing results.
interpretation: Conditional quasi-static screening; sensitivity values are deliberately chosen perturbations, not measured distributions or reliability estimates.

common.gravity_cases: flat plus eight equally spaced slope headings

contact_loss.recovery_motion: none; test instantaneous four-contact equilibrium only

geometry.scope: every modeled solid pair; no unlisted waivers
geometry.classification: same-leg envelopes and frame joints are unresolved interfaces, never a clearance pass; all other overlaps are packaging conflicts

controls: frictionless nonzero slope must be infeasible
synthetic boxes must detect overlap and reject separated/touching as volumetric overlap
synthetic bench record must remain non-evidence; corrupt/missing/short/gapped/over-limit inputs must fail
stop_rule: Report retained and closed claims; do not optimize geometry or parameters against these outcomes. A revision, if needed, requires a separate explicit change and new verification.
